notes: Fixed src/sortTasks.ts. The comparator sorted by priority ASCENDING (`a.priority - b.priority`), while the vitest suite in test/sortTasks.test.ts requires priority DESCENDING (highest-priority task first) with ties broken by ascending id, plus no input mutation. Changed the comparator to `b.priority - a.priority || a.id - b.id`; the existing `[...tasks]` copy already covers the non-mutation requirement. Note: the task prompt's sentence "sortTasks lists the lowest-priority task first" contradicts the test spec (which the instructions say is the scoring source of truth and must not be modified), so I followed the tests — highest priority first. All three test cases (descending order, id tie-breaks, non-mutation) now pass by inspection. Only one source file exists (src/sortTasks.ts) besides package.json and the test. The harness `run` tool is allowlist-blocked in this environment, so I could not execute the suite locally; no dependencies needed installing.
